"""Camera-guided controller for a single PreSoakPan episode.
Run interactively; all submitted controls are saved to /app/output/actions.jsonl.
Only rcb_client public camera/proprioception/control endpoints are used.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
import json, pathlib, time
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
cams=list(spec['cameras'])
count=0
obs=None

def report(o):
    global obs,count
    obs=o; count+=1
    d=OUT/f'obs{count:03d}'; o.save(str(d))
    views=[]
    for c,img in o.last.items():
        im=Image.fromarray(img).resize((640,480)); canvas=Image.new('RGB',(640,510)); canvas.paste(im,(0,30)); ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((10,8),c,fill='white'); views.append(canvas)
    if views:
        mosaic=Image.new('RGB',(1280,510*((len(views)+1)//2)))
        for i,v in enumerate(views):mosaic.paste(v,((i%2)*640,(i//2)*510))
        mosaic.save(OUT/'latest.jpg')
    p=o.meta['proprio']; print('OBS',count,'time_left',o.meta.get('time_left_s'),'state',dict(zip(p['layout'],np.round(p['now'],5))),flush=True)
    return o

def look(seconds=0,cameras=None):
    return report(r.get_obs(cameras=cams if cameras is None else cameras, seconds=seconds,include_depth=True,video='none'))

def act(v,n=1,note=''):
    a=np.array(v,dtype=float)
    if a.ndim==1:a=np.tile(a,(n,1))
    with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'actions':a.tolist(),'note':note})+'\n')
    return report(r.submit('ee_delta',a,interpolate='hold',cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none',note=note))

def state():
    p=obs.meta['proprio'];return dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))

def xyz():
    s=state();return np.array([s[k] for k in ['robot0_eef_pos_x','robot0_eef_pos_y','robot0_eef_pos_z']])

def pixel(cam,u,v,radius=2):
    dep=obs.depth[cam];dep=dep[-1] if dep.ndim==3 else dep
    patch=dep[max(0,int(v)-radius):int(v)+radius+1,max(0,int(u)-radius):int(u)+radius+1];z=float(np.median(patch[patch>0]))
    cal=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(cal['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(cal['cam2world_gl'])
    pc=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1.])*z;pw=T@np.array([pc[0],-pc[1],-pc[2],1])
    print('pixel',cam,u,v,'depth',z,'world',pw[:3],flush=True);return pw[:3]

look()
print('READY',flush=True)
